scope: Bounded source construction and effective endpoint views. These clauses do not qualify complete type semantics, inherited scope, computed generals, variability or validators.

requirements: Conjugated and original types redefine relationship source and target; an owning Type is also the conjugated Type.
Specific and general types redefine relationship source and target; the owning Type is also the specific Type.
Subclassifier and superclassifier redefine specific and general with Classifier endpoint types.
Usage composition defaults are conditional on ref, usage category, direction, end status and featuring ownership; PortUsage has an additional ownership condition.
isReference is the logical negation of isComposite.
